core_obligations: Let Y' \subset X' be the exceptional divisor. Let Z' \subset Y' be the inverse image of Z \subset Y.
Let y' \in U' \cap Y' and let \mathfrak p' \subset \mathcalO_X', y'^\wedge be a prime ideal not contained in V(I\mathcalO_X', y'^\wedge).
Choose (b|_U'^*\mathcalF_n) \to (\mathcalF_n'') and (\mathcalH_n) in \textitCoh(U', I\mathcalO_U') as in Lemma \reflemma-improvement-formal-coherent-module-better.
If A is I-adically complete we can finish the proof as follows.
proof_roadmap: 第 1 步：Let Y' \subset X' be the exceptional divisor. Let Z' \subset Y' be the inverse image of Z \subset Y.
第 2 步：Let y' \in U' \cap Y' and let \mathfrak p' \subset \mathcalO_X', y'^\wedge be a prime ideal not contained in V(I\mathcalO_X', y'^\wedge).
第 3 步：Conditions (b) and (d) of Lemma \reflemma-improvement-formal-coherent-module-better.
第 5 步：Choose (b|_U'^*\mathcalF_n) \to (\mathcalF_n'') and (\mathcalH_n) in \textitCoh(U', I\mathcalO_U') as in Lemma \reflemma-improvement-formal-coherent-module-better.
第 6 步：If A is I-adically complete we can finish the proof as follows.
difficulty_reason: H2: Under the exact original dualizing-complex, blowup-fibre-dimension≤d-1 and alternative depth inequalities, extend the formal coherent system to X for an arbitrary ideal I. The author proof7317-7581 constructs T′⊂T on the exceptional divisor, compares completed affine blowup charts and their Gorenstein formal fibres, derives the two depth/dimension/delta transport inequalities, handles the exceptional one-dimensional branch, constructs canonical local extensions on the blowup and glues them, then descends by proper formal existence and the push-pull map with I-power-torsion kernel/cokernel. The final paragraph reduces noncomplete A to completion; no completeness or principal-ideal hypothesis is added. This is the actual geometric inequality-transport/descent construction, not merely a restatement of the cd1 criterion.

dedup.scope: Fixed author tag/claim/current primary metadata lookup and actual statement comparison with listed concrete neighbours; complete own author proof read, no full-library equivalence certification.
dedup.basis: Existing072 assumes cd(A,I)=1 and a pro-isomorphic system meeting the canonical-extension depth bound. Existing7990 treats the local principal-ideal (2,3)-inequality family. The present original statement permits arbitrary I with a blowup-fibre-dimension bound and requires the author blowup transport/gluing/descent proof; no claim that these different assumptions are identical.

original_difficulty_reason: 代数化问题沿 I 的爆破的下降：作者自建从 X 的爆破 b:X′→X 出发的完整归约链。先取例外除子 Y′ 与其逆像 Z′、令 U′=X′\Z′，用 δ 函数定义特化稳定的子集 T′⊂T，再把 (F_n) 拉回到 Coh(U′,IO_{U′}) 并对偶化；随后逐点核对不等式在爆破下的传播，用平坦基变换的爆破引理把完备情形（A 带对偶复形、纤维维数下降）逐个条件搬回一般情形，最后得「完备情形推出一般情形」。这套把代数化判据在爆破前后逐条搬运的论证由本条完成。
